components.name: Tomato base
components.note: The tomato base sits beneath the mozzarella and meat toppings, forming the foundation of this richly topped pizza.

components.name: Mozzarella
components.note: Mozzarella provides the cheese element of the base, alongside the tomato and beneath the spicy chicken and pulled pork.

components.name: Spicy chicken strips
components.note: The chicken strips bring spice to the topping, contrasting with the smoky sweetness of the pulled pork rib meat.

components.name: Pulled pork rib meat
components.note: Tender pulled pork rib meat adds smoky, sweet flavours and a softer meat texture alongside the spicy chicken strips.

components.name: Garlic mayonnaise
components.note: A drizzle of creamy garlic mayonnaise finishes the pizza with tangy garlic flavour and adds to its mouth-coating richness.

taste:
This is a rich, hearty pizza built around the contrast between spicy chicken and smoky, sweet pulled pork rib meat. The chicken strips bring the spice, while the tender pulled pork gives the topping a softer texture. Tomato and mozzarella form the base beneath both meats, making this a choice for someone who wants several strong flavours rather than a simpler cheese-led pizza.

Creamy garlic mayonnaise adds a tangy finish and contributes to the mouth-coating texture. Served hot, the pizza leans towards richness rather than restraint. Expect the combination of meat, mozzarella and mayonnaise to be the main attraction, with the pork's sweetness balancing the spiced chicken rather than removing its heat.

bestFor.title: Rich flavour preferences

bestFor.title: Spice with sweetness
bestFor.text: This suits someone who likes spicy chicken alongside sweeter meat flavours. The pulled pork brings smoky sweetness, though the description does not establish a precise heat level.
